I. Called to order @ 1822

  A. Present: Jimmy (Treasurer), Kyle (Secretery), Joe (President), Susan (Officer), Kevin


II. Old Business

  A. the new lease

    1. the internet situation

      a. Internet not explicitly included

      b. Alternative: two year plan with comcast is approx. $90/month

      c. will ask for clarifying language

      d. Gigabitnow is ~$10000 to trench from road, Mark will not pay for

    2. Water Intrusion

      a. leak from plumbing vent has been fixed, caused damage on inner wall of workshop

      b. leak in admin closet, outer wall of workshop, and fab lab caused by driving rain

        i. happens so rarely not a concern

      c. Metalshop and Lounge caused by poor drainage overflowing slab foundation

        i. we have been given wide latitude to identify and present solutions

        ii. we have been given wide latitude to implement solutions ourselves, with reimbursement

    3. have been given permission to modify/remove the island in the woodshop

      a. must give plans for water and power connections

      b. Mark doesn't want any materials returnes to them

    4. have requested price list for storage units next door

    5. Does anyone else have a relationship with Mark?

      a. Jimmy is primary point of contact

      b. Pete, Nathan, Kevin have worked with Mark before

  B. Membership Rate Changes

    1. June 2026: Income $2075 ; Expenses $2390.88 ; Net: -$315.88

    2. Previous dues increase was 2019

    3. 30 Class I members, 19 Class II members

    4. Option 1: target rate increase to cover next three years

      a. Option: $80 regular rate, $40 Hardship rate

      b. Option: add $30 to each rate

        i. any less than approx. $30 risk the viability of Bloominglabs

    5. Option A: Phased increase over the next three years

    6. changes to hardship rate ex. requiring volunteer hours

      a. Option: require volunteer hours

        i. create library of tasks to be done

        ii. # of hours required per month - 6

    7. Special Membership Meeting scheduled at 2026-07-11 at 1000


III. Postponed for lack of time

  C. discuss the policies that the membership charged us with drafting

  D. materials and project storage policy

  E. pet policy

  F. project vehicle and general parking policy

  G. the new financial software


IIII. Adjourned @ 2005

  A. Next scheduled meeting is 2026-07-08 at 1730
